 Speaker’s Card/Request to Speak: If you would like to address the City Council on a scheduled agenda
 item, please complete the Request to Speak Form. The card is at the table at the entrance to the Council
 Chamber. Please identify on the card your name, address, and the item on which you would like to speak
 and return to the City Clerk. The Request to Speak Form assists the Mayor in ensuring that all persons
 wishing to address the Council are recognized. Your name will be called at the time the matter is heard
 by the Council.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

1.  CLOSED SESSION

  1.1  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION
  (Pursuant to subdivision (a) of Government Code Section 54956.9):
  CoxCom, Inc. v. City of Irvine, U.S. District Court Case No. SACV 05-
  1240-JVS

RECESS

RECONVENE TO THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING - 5:00 P.M.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

MOMENT OF SILENCE

MUSICAL PRESENTATION
 City Council Agenda  May 8, 2007

2.  PRESENTATIONS

  2.1  Presentation of gifts from Taoyuan, Taiwan

  2.2  Red Ribbon Pizza Night Check Presentation to the Youth Action
  Team

  2.3  Presentation on Alternative Fuel Vehicles

INTRODUCTIONS

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

ANNOUNCEMENTS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/COUNCIL REPORTS

  Announcements, Committee Reports and Council Comments are for the purpose of presenting
  brief comments or reports, are subject to California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and are limited to 15 minutes per meeting

ADDITIONS AND DELETIONS

  Additions to the agenda are limited by California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and for those items that arise after the posting of the Agenda and must be acted upon
  prior to the next City Council meeting

3.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and enacted by one roll
  call vote. There will be no discussion of these items unless members of the City Council request
  specific items to be removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion. Any member of
  the public may address the Council on items on the Consent Calendar. Public comments on any
  item or items on the consent calendar are limited to three minutes per speaker. If you wish to
  speak to a particular item or items, please complete a Speakers Form and give it to the City
  Clerk

  3.1  MINUTES

  ACTION:  Approve the minutes of a regular City Council meeting
  held on April 24, 2007.

  3.2  PROCLAMATIONS

  ACTION:
  1)  Proclaim May 8, 2007 as "Arbor Day."
  2)  Proclaim May 2007 as "Asian Pacific Islander American Heritage
  Month."

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  2
 City Council Agenda  May 8, 2007

  3.3  WARRANT AND WIRE TRANSFER RESOLUTION

  ACTION:  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ALLOWING CERTAIN
  CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID

  3.4  WARRANT AND WIRE TRANSFER RESOLUTION - AT&T

  ACTION:  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ALLOWING CERTAIN
  CLAIMS AND DEMANDS OF AT&T AND SPECIFYING THE
  FUNDS OUT OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID

  3.5  WARRANT AND WIRE TRANSFER RESOLUTION - BANK OF
  AMERICA

  ACTION:  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ALLOWING CERTAIN
  CLAIMS AND DEMANDS OF BANK OF AMERICA AND
  SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO
  BE PAID

  3.6  BUDGET ADJUSTMENT FOR PLANNING AREA 1 NORTH IRVINE
  TRANSPORTATION MITIGATION FEES

  ACTION:  Approve a Budget Adjustment transferring $814,109
  from Assessment District Fund 220 to North Irvine Transportation
  Mitigation (NITM) Fund 122.

  3.7  CULVER DRIVE REHABILITATION FROM BARRANCA PARKWAY TO
  THE I-405 FREEWAY - CIP 317180

  ACTION:  Approve the plans, specifications, and contract
  documents for Culver Drive Rehabilitation from Barranca Parkway
  to the I-405 Freeway, CIP 317180, on file with the Public Works
  Department.

  3.8  CITY OF IRVINE INVESTMENT POLICY FOR THE CALENDAR YEAR
  2007

  ACTION:
  1)  Receive and file the City of Irvine Investment Policy for the
  Calendar Year 2007.

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  3
 City Council Agenda  May 8, 2007

  2)  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ADOPTING THE CITY'S
  ANNUAL INVESTMENT POLICY FOR CALENDAR YEAR 2007.

  3.9  UNIVERSITY DRIVE REHABILITATION FROM HARVARD AVENUE TO
  THE I-405 FREEWAY - CIP 317270

  ACTION:  Approve the plans, specifications, and contract
  documents for University Drive Rehabilitation from Harvard Avenue
  to the I-405 Freeway, CIP 317270, on file with the Public Works
  Department.

  3.10  FINANCING AND COOPERATION AGREEMENT FOR THE GRANITE
  COURT AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROJECT

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve Financing and Cooperation Agreement for the Granite
  Court Affordable Housing Project.
  2)  Approve Budget Adjustment Request.

  3.11  REDEVELOPMENT FUND BUDGET ADJUSTMENTS

  ACTION:  Approve the budget adjustments revising tax
  increment budgeted revenue estimates; appropriating pass-through
  payments and administrative expenditures; and creating a special
  fund for such transactions.

  3.12  ORDINANCE NO. 07-12, AUTHORIZING CITY ENGINEER AUTHORITY
  TO REVIEW AND APPROVE OR DISAPPROVE FINAL TRACT MAPS
  AND ASSOCIATED BONDS AND AGREEMENTS, AND TO ACCEPT
  STREETS INTO THE CITY STREET SYSTEM

  ACTION:  Read by title and adopt ORDINANCE NO. 07-12 - AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING CHAPTERS 1, 7, AND 12, OF
  DIVISION 5 OF TITLE 5 OF THE IRVINE MUNICIPAL CODE
  RELATING TO SUBDIVISIONS AND AMENDING CHAPTER 2 OF
  DIVISION 3 OF TITLE 6 OF THE IRVINE MUNICIPAL CODE
  RELATING TO TRANSPORTATION

  3.13  BUDGET ADJUSTMENT AND CLOSURE - ROCKFIELD AND
  OLDFIELD TRAFFIC SIGNAL INSTALLATION – CAPITAL
  IMPROVEMENT PROJECT (CIP) 311810

  ACTION:

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  4
 City Council Agenda  May 8, 2007

  1)  Approve a budget adjustment increasing revenues and
  corresponding appropriations in the amount of $82,652 from
  Hazard Elimination Safety grant (HES) and Transfer-In from Gas
  Tax in the amount of $8,310 to the Rockfield and Oldfield Traffic
  Signal Installation project, CIP 311810.
  2)  Approve the closure of Rockfield and Oldfield Traffic Signal
  Installation project, CIP 311810, with $383,100 in total
  expenditures.

END OF CONSENT CALENDAR

4.  FIRST READING OF ORDINANCES

  4.1  ORDINANCE TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF SENATE
  BILL 53, TO DESCRIBE THE IRVINE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  PROVISIONS AND LIMITATIONS FOR EMINENT DOMAIN

  ACTION:  Introduce for first reading and read by title only
  ORDINANCE NO. - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF IRVINE CONFORMING TO THE REQUIREMENTS
  OF SENATE BILL 53, CHAPTER 591 OF STATUTES OF 2006, AS
  CODIFIED IN CALIFORNIA HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE
  SECTION 33342.7, TO DESCRIBE THE IRVINE
  REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY'S PROVISIONS AND LIMITATIONS
  FOR REAL PROPERTY ACQUISITION BY EMINENT DOMAIN

5.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  Public Hearings are scheduled for a time certain of 4:00 p.m., unless noticed otherwise, or as
  soon thereafter as possible. Those wishing to address the City Council during the Public
  Hearing must complete a form and provide it to the City Clerk prior to the hearing.
  Notice: Public Hearings listed for continuance will be continued as noted and posting of this
  agenda serves as notice of continuation. Any matter not noted for continuance, will be posted
  separately

  5.1  ORDINANCE RELATING TO STATE AND LOCAL FRANCHISES FOR
  CABLE COMMUNICATIONS AND FRANCHISE AGREEMENT WITH
  COX COMMUNICATIONS

  ACTION:
  1)  Introduce for first reading and read by title only ORDINANCE NO. -
  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  IRVINE RELATING TO STATE AND LOCAL FRANCHISES FOR
  CABLE COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEMS AND GRANTING A
  FRANCHISE TO COXCOM, INC. DBA COX COMMUNICATIONS

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  5
 City Council Agenda  May 8, 2007

  2)  Approve a budget adjustment to receive $929,860 of the Cox
  Settlement Agreement Payment into the General Fund Strategic
  Surplus (Fund Balance).
  3)  Approve a budget adjustment to transfer $3,070,140 of the Cox
  Franchise Agreement Grant Payment to the Technology Fund
  (Fund 579) and allocate for upgrading the video system in the City
  Council Chambers ($1,750,000) to conform with Federal
  Communication Standards and for future video related projects
  ($1,320,140).

6.  COUNCIL BUSINESS

  6.1  2007 STRATEGIC BUSINESS PLAN

  ACTION:  Adopt the 2007 Strategic Business Plan.

  6.2  CONSIDERATION OF PARKING REQUIREMENTS IN COMMERCIAL
  CENTERS

  ACTION:  City Council discussion and direction.

  6.3  ORANGE COUNTY GREAT PARK CORPORATION BALLOON
  PROJECT BID, ADD ALTERNATES, AND PROPOSED BUDGET
  ADJUSTMENT

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve a budget adjustment to the Fiscal Year 2006-2007 Great
  Park budget reducing the anticipated contribution from Heritage
  Fields by $155,700.
  2)  Approve an increase to the Orange County Great Park Balloon
  Project Budget (CIP No. 377040) by $179,300 to reestablish the
  project contingency.
  3)  Provide direction to staff to add any or all of the following options to
  the Orange County Great Park Balloon Project (CIP No. 377040):

  Option 1: Asphalt roadway with wood header edges that connects
  Marine Way to the balloon site, and asphalt paving extension on
  the east side of the parking lot, and bus parking lot paint lines
  ($154,688).

  Option 2: Timeline painting mock-up and the timeline painting
  ($10,224).

  Option 3: 47-36" box citrus trees with irrigation and mulch for
  ground cover ($18,286).

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  6
 City Council Agenda  May 8, 2007

  Option 4: Planting of areas outside of the balloon berm, installation
  of irrigation, and hydro seed ($61,695).

  Option 5: Center paint line and orange dots for entire length of
  entrance drive from the entry guard shack to the balloon parking lot
  ($14,376).

  4)  Provide direction to staff to purchase the visitors center tent at an
  additional project cost of $244,000.
  5)  Approve a budget adjustment allocating funds from the OCGP
  Fund 180 fund balance in the amount identified in
  recommendations 1 and 2, and any option(s) directed from
  recommendation 3 and 4 above.

  6.4  ORANGE COUNTY GREAT PARK CORPORATION CONTRACT
  EXTENSION AND BUDGET AMENDMENT REQUEST

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve a budget adjustment increasing the Fiscal Year 2006-2007
  Great Park budget for the Great Park Design Studio by $2,208,039.
  2)  Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract amendment to
  the Master Designer Agreement incorporating the $2,208,039
  budget increase for Task 7.

END OF COUNCIL BUSINESS

PUBLIC COMMENTS (Limited to 3 minutes per speaker) - 6:00 P.M.

ADJOURNMENT

Next Meeting: CITY COUNCIL REGULAR meeting, May 22, 2007, 4:00 p.m., City of
Irvine, City Council Chamber, One Civic Center Plaza, Irvine, California.
  NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
  LIVE BROADCASTING
City Council meetings are broadcasted live every 2nd and 4th Tuesday of the month at 4:00 p.m. and are
replayed on Sundays at 11:00 a.m., and Thursdays at 7:00 p.m. All broadcasts can be viewed on Cox
Communications Local Access Channel 30. City Council meetings are also available via live webcast
through the City’s website at www.cityofirvine.org. For more information, please contact the City Clerk’s
office at (949)724-6205.
  ADJOURNMENT
At 11:00 p.m., the City Council will determine which of the remaining agenda items can be considered
and acted upon prior to 12:00 midnight and will continue all other items on which additional time is
required until a future City Council meeting. All meetings are scheduled to terminate at 12:00 midnight.
  STAFF REPORTS

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  7
 City Council Agenda  May 8, 2007

As a general rule, staff reports or other written documentation have been prepared or organized with
respect to each item of business listed on the agenda. Copies of these materials are on file with the City
Clerk and are available for public inspection and copying. Staff reports can also be downloaded from the
City’s website at http://www.ci.irvine.ca.us/council/agenda/agenda_archive.asp beginning the Friday prior
to the scheduled City Council meeting on Tuesday.

In addition, meetings can be viewed live at the time posted on the agenda and related staff reports can be
opened and viewed simultaneously along with the streaming of the meeting. To view the meeting, go to
http://irvine.granicus.com/ViewPublisher.php?view_id=6.
If you have any questions regarding any item of business on the agenda for this meeting, or any of the
staff reports or other documentation relating to any agenda item, please contact City Clerk staff at
(949)724-6205.
  CITY SERVICES TO FACILITATE ACCESS TO PUBLIC MEETINGS
It is the intention of the City of Irvine to comply with the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) in all
respects. If, as an attendee or a participant at this meeting, you will need special assistance beyond what
is normally provided, the City of Irvine will attempt to accommodate you in every reasonable manner.
Please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (949)724-6205.

Assisted listening devices are available at the meeting for individuals with hearing impairments.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35. 104 ADA Title II)
  CHALLENGING CITY DECISIONS
The time limit within which to commence any lawsuit or legal challenge to any quasi-adjudicative decision
made by the City is governed by Section 1094.6 of the Code of Civil Procedure, unless a shorter
limitations period is specified by any other provision. Under Section 1094.6, any lawsuit or legal challenge
to any quasi-adjudicative decision made by the City must be filed no later than the 90th day following the
date on which such decision becomes final. Any lawsuit or legal challenge, which is not filed within that
90-day period, will be barred.

If a person wishes to challenge the nature of the above actions in court, they may be limited to raising
only those issues they or someone else raised at the meeting described in this notice, or in written
correspondence delivered to the City of Irvine, at or prior to the meeting. In addition, judicial challenge
may be limited or barred where the interested party has not sought and exhausted all available
administrative remedies.
  COMMUNICATION DEVICES
To minimize distractions, please be sure all personal communication devices are turned off or on silent
mode.
  MEETING SCHEDULE
Regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesdays of each month at 4:00
p.m. Study Sessions and/or Closed Sessions are periodically held prior to the start of the regular meeting.
Agendas are available as follows:
